name: v11.6.4
body:
## What's Changed
* fix: show 1.0 MB instead of 1024.0 kB in ByteCountDecimal by @ChandraChaan in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1414
* fix: harden transferes and limiters by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1423
* feat: add --no-update-check to skip the transfer update check by @costajohnt in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1417
* fix(utils): only bypass the proxy for addresses that are actually local by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1422
* fix: receive --text on Windows without a resume prompt by @nk-batman21 in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1416
* chore: update dependencies by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1424

## New Contributors
* @ChandraChaan made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1414
* @kevin9327 made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1422
* @nk-batman21 made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1416

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/schollz/croc/compare/v11.6.3...v11.6.4
